description: Hourly electricity demand data for Iceland 2021--October 2024. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dan Hawkins (Delft University of Technology). A curated hourly national electricity-demand dataset for Iceland. The dataset provides a continuous hourly UTC grid for 2019–2025, with observed values for 2021–October 2024 and explicit null values where observations are unavailable. See README.md for source provenance, transformations and validation. Coverage: national (IS); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
